name: openbb_equity_management
description:
Executives and key officers of one company (name, title, pay where available) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.management).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, yfinance; default yfinance).
Company profile: openbb_equity_profile; another source: fmp_key_executives. Keys: yfinance needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
